title: Father's life, brother who knows jazz history, his address
summary: Joseph knows little of his father's early life; he points to his brother as a knowledgeable source and gives his address, and recalls his father leaving instruments out for the children.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: That's right, somebody did tell me about the string instruments. I forgot about it, who it was, told us about it. Yeah. Is there anything at all, I don't like to just keep pumping you about information on your father, because naturally I mean you couldn't remember, he probably didn't tell you everything about his life, but I was just I wondered, did he ever tell you anything when he started in music? How old was he too when he died?
Well I think my father was 54, 55 when he died.

By being the last one, you know, I mean, you wouldn't have all the information like the older boys, you know, like my brother Furtin' there, well he know all about that. Tell you the truth, he know a lot about this jazz business too. I mean a lot of it. He really knows. Nobody never, you know, talks to him.
By the way, do you have his address in mind, I mean, can you tell us where he lives and we'll make a note here on the tape so that we can, uh.
Oh he used to be 14, 1477 Northern Roman.
Seven, 1477 Northern Roman. Yeah well he, I tell you Bill, he'd be by the Union Hall all the time, you know the place where he'd be there.
Yeah, which are on the Esplanade.
Well, Columbus and, not Esplanade, Columbus and Cleveland.
Yeah, that's right. He know all about that.
Yeah, we'll have to talk to him too and he could probably get more information about that.

Well you see my daddy was a fellow like this, he loved music and he didn't want, and he had five boys and two girls, so his idea was just to put the instrument there, now who liked it take it, and who didn't. So I wound up liking it and I went through it lots of, you know, the right way.
